s: strI, (sunAmA dvAdaSI । yadvA, sunAmapriyA dvAdaSI .) dvAdaSamAsIyadvAdaSakarttavyavrataviSezaH । yaTA, -- ambarIza uvAca । “kaTaM sunAmaBirdevo dvAdaSyAM munisattam । pUjyate keSavo marttyErBuktikAmaPalArTiBiH ॥ vaSizWa uvAca । SfRuzvEkamanA BUyaH sunAmadvAdaSIM SuBAm । sarvvapApaharAM svargyAM BuktimuktipradAyikAm ॥ manasApi cikIrzanti ye dvAdaSIM narottamAH । te'pi GoraM na paSyanti punaH saMsArasAgaram ॥ AdyaM sarvvavratAnAntu vEzRavAnAM nfpottama । narEH strIBiSca karttavyaM vizRostuzwikaraM param ॥ * mArgaSIrze SuBe mAsi Suklapakze yatavrataH । praTamaM cEva gfhRoyAt dvAdaSIM viDivannaraH ॥ manovAkkAyacezwABiH sa viSudDo jitendriyaH । daSamyAM niyataH snAtvA praRiMpatya janArddanam ॥ havizyAnnakftAhAraH SucirBUtvA BavedvratI । upalipte SucO deSe Bakzayet dantaDAvanam ॥ upozyEkAdaSIM samyak pUjayitvA janArddanam । sunAmadvAdaSIM deva ahaM Bokzye pare'hani ॥ evaM saNkalpya niyamaM praRamya garuqaDvajam । daSamyAmekaBaktASI saMyataH saMvasenniSAm ॥ ekAdaSyAM tataH kuryyAdekacittaH samAhitaH । pUrvvaM prapUjayet sUryyaM tatodevaM prapUjayet ॥ namaste devadeveSa namaste Baktavatsala । BAskarAya namastuByaM ravaye kAryyaBAnave ॥ namaH sUryyAya devAya namaste saptasaptaye । ekasmE hi namastuByamekacakraraTAya ca ॥ jyotizAM pataye nityaM savvatejoharAya ca । divAkara namaste'stu praBAkara namo'stu te ॥ evaM saMpUjya viDivat puzpaDUpAnulepanEH । dIpErvvastrEH sunEvedyEstato vizRugfhaM vrajet ॥ tato'nu snApayeddevaM daDikzIraGftAdiBiH । sarvvOzaDijalEH puRyEstaTA candanavAriBiH ॥ kuNkamoSIrakapUrEScandanena vilepayet । acyutaM cArccayedBaktyA mAlatIkusumErBfSam ॥ gugguluM GftasaMyuktaM DUpaM dadyAdaharniSam । pAyasApUpasaMyAvakaramBAjyakadambakEH ॥ nEvedyaM haraye dadyAt PalamodakaMyAnvitEH । gItavAdyErharerhyeza praRamecca muhurmuhuH ॥ evaM pUjAM hareH kftvA dvijaM jYAnapradAyakam । pUjayedantaraM nAsti viprakeSavayorapi ॥ tato'vraRaM samAlaBya candanena navaM Gawam । sragviRaM toyasampUrRaM nyaseddevasya sanniDO ॥ sahemamOktikAkzantu vajraratnasuvarRakam । nyasya garBe savastrantu pUjayettatra keSavam ॥ yasya romni sTitA meGAH sarvvasanDizu pannagAH ॥ sAgarAH kukzideSasTAH so'trAyAtu jagatpati । vanaspatiraso divyaH sarvvaganDezu cottamaH । Gftena sahasonmiSro DUpo'yaM pratigfhyatAm ॥ keSavaH keSihA keSikaMsArizwanisUdanaH । sarvvakAmaprado devaH sa me pApaM vyapohatu ॥ evamaByarccya deveSaM praRipatya kzamApayet । dvAdaSyAM tatra toyena snApayettena mAnavaH ॥ sarvvapApavinirmukto vEzRavIM laBate tanum । kftABizekaH puRyAtmA samyagaByarccya keSavam ॥ navanItakftAM DenuM vrAhmaRAyopapAdayet । kaSavaH prIyatAM devaH keSihantA mahAcyutaH । sa me Bavettu suprItaH izwAn kAmAn prayacCatu । evaM pradakziRaM kftvA SfRu tasyApi yat Palam ॥ triMSadabdakfta pApaM hitvA sa triviDaM naraH । zazwiM varzasahasrARi svarge modati devavat ॥ yadA kAlAdihAyAti saDarmmo DanavAn Bavet aBAvAdaTa DenUnAM tat pAtraM kalpayettataH ॥ tatPalaM hi vinirddizwaM yaTASaktyA tu dakziRA । BaktyA PalaM samApnoti BaktirevAtra kAraRam ॥ * pOzasyEva tu mAsasya yo'pyevaM kzapayennaraH । samAhitamanA BUpa rasaDenupradAyakaH ॥ Apo nArA iti proktA Apo vE narasUnavaH । ayanaM vartmanI tasmAt nArAyaRa iti smftaH ॥ nArAyaRaH prIyatAM me devo narapriyaH sadA । izwakAmaprado nityaM sa me pApaM vyapohatu ॥ tataH pradakziRaM kftvA brAhmaRAn BojayettataH । evaM hi pOzamAsasya tasya puRyaPalaM SfRu ॥ zazwyA vAbdEH kftaM pApaM svalpaM vA yadi vA bahu hatvA svargaM samApnoti varzARAmayutAyutam ॥ * ॥ mAGasyEva tu mAsasya dvAdaSIM SuklapakzataH । yaH kzipedDi SucirBUtvA ekacittaH samAhitaH ॥ snApane pUjane nityaM brAhmaRAnAYca tarpaRe । pradAne nfpaSArddUla imaM mantramudIrayet ॥ mA lakzmISca purAtreyI BaginI SaSino'nujA । BarttA tvamapi tasyASca sarvvakAmada mADava ॥ prIyatAM mADavo devo maDukEwaBasUdanaH । vAsudevo jagannATo mama pApaM vyapohatu ॥ evaM yaH kurute sadyastasya puRyaPalaM SfRu । yAvajjanmakftaM pApaM hatvA sarvvamaSezataH ॥ divyavarzasahasrARi svarge vasati zoqaSa । guqaDenuprado mAGe ihAyAtaH sadA suKI ॥ BavedrAjan nirAtaNkaH putrESvaryyasamanvitaH । tatra vizRuparo BUtvA kramAnmokzamavApnu yAt ॥ * ॥ PAlgunAmalapakzasya dvAdaSyAM niyataH SuciH । pUjayitvA viDAnena devadevaM svaSaktitaH ॥ mantreRAnena rAjendra govindaH proyatAmiti । gavA Bakto'si gosvAmo govAso gokftAlayaH sarvvakAmaprado nityaM sa me pApaM vyapohatu । stutvavaM SarkarADenuM BaktyA dadyAt dvijAtaye ॥ tataH pradakziRaM kftvA SfRu puRyaM yaTAtaTam । valovarddasahasrARAM daSAnAM DUrvivAhinAm ॥ na taMstat PaMlamApnoti dvAdaSyA yadBavennfpa । divyavazasahasrARi svarge tizWati svargivat ॥ * ॥ cEtrasya dvAdaSIM SuklAM samupozya nfpottama । snAtvA prapUjayedvizRuM jagato'ntaracAriRam ॥ pUrvvAktaviDivat snAtvA gomUtrErgOmayena ca । snApayitvAmftenEva paYcAnAM ganDasaMyutEH ॥ adBiH paScAt prapUjyEvaM ganDaDUpavilepanEH । puzpErvvAsoBirevaM hi mantreRAnena budDimAn ॥ praveSane yaTASIlo jagatAM rakzaRAya ca । durvfttAnAM vinirjetumasi vizRurato hare ॥ vizRurBavatu me prIto vizRurdevaH sanAtanaH । sarvvapApavinASAya viRurme prIyatAmiti ॥ maDuDenumaBAvAcca SaktitaH pAtrameva ca । dattvA yat PalamApnoti tadihEkamanAH SfRu ॥ pUrvvajammani yat pApamiha janmani sAmpratam । varttate sakalaM hatvA svargaloke mahIyate ॥ * ॥ vESAKasya tu mAsasya pUjayenmaDusUdanam । pUrvvIktaviDinA rAjan sOvarRaM maDusUdanam ॥ jalakumBe tu saMsTApya mantreRAnena pUjayet । ekArRave jale DAturhftA vedAH purA hare ॥ maDunA te hataH so'pi tenAsi maDusUdanaH । sa me Bavatu suprIto devadevaH sanAtanaH ॥ sarvvapApavinASAya prIyatAM maDusUdanaH । GftaDenumaTo dattvA vrAhmaRAn BojayettataH ॥ tataH pradakziRaM kuryyAt dattvA deyAn yaTopagAn evantu kzapamARasya tasya puRyaPalaM SfRu ॥ kapilAnAM sahasrasya samyagdattasya puzkare । tatPalaM samavApnoti Baktiyukto'pyasaMSayaH । yAvadindro vaset svarge tAvadeva sa tizWati ॥ * ॥ jyEzWasyEva tu mAsasya Sruklapakze tu dDAdaSIm । pUjayedviDivadBaktyA samupozya triviMkramam ॥ jalaDenumaTo dadyAdviprAya niyataH SuciH । yajYaBAgaBujo dEtyAn sannihatya kramEstriBiH ॥ trElokyamAhftaM tasmAt tenAsi tvaM trivikramaH trivikramaM trilokeSaM prIRayAmi trivikramam ॥ tataH pradakziRaM kftvA brAhmaReByaSca dakziRAm । vattvA tu BojayettAMstu SfRu tasyApi yat Palam vAjapeyasya yajYasya samyagizwasya pArTiva । tatPalaM laBate marttyaH paratreha suKI Bavet ॥ * ॥ vAmanastu taTAzAQe samupozya prayatnataH । dvAdaSIniyatAhAro vAmanaM tatra pUjayet ॥ hitAya sarvvadevAnAM AdityaH kAmado yaTA । taTA tvaM Bava me deva vAmano valibanDanaH ॥ tilaDenuM tato dadyAt vAmanaH prIyatAmiti । tadaBAvAttaTA pAtraM yaTASaktyA ca dakziRAm ॥ pUrvvajanmakftaM pApamihajanmakftaYca yat । tat sarvvaM vinihatyASu paratra ca SuBAM gatim ॥ * ॥ SrAvaRasya tu mAsasya dvAdaSyAM SuklapakzataH । yaH kzipenniyato BUtvA samupozya janArddanam ॥ samarccayet yaTASaktyA pUrvvoktaviDinA tataH । DenuM sarvvaguRopetAM brAhmaRAya nivedayet ॥ mantreRAnena rAjendra pOrARavihitena ca । samAdAya tato lakzmIM lokeByaH kzIrasAgare । svapizi SrAvaRe mAsi SrIDaro'si jagatpate ! ॥ SrAvaRe SrIDaro devaH SrIvatsaH SroniketanaH । prIyatAM hi SriyaH kAnto gatimizwAM dadAtu me gavAM daSasahasreRa pAtradattena yat Palam । sakalaM laBate martyo Baktiyukto na saMSayaH । svargezu vipulAn BogAn Bunakti surarAqiva ॥ * ॥ tenEva viDinA rAjan mAse BAdrapade tataH । samupozya tato BaktyA hfzIkeSaM prapUjayet ॥ muktADenumaTo dadyAt yaTAviBavavistarAt । hfSIkARIndriyARyAhustezAmISo jagatpatiH ॥ karoti karttfBUto'sO hfzIkeSo BatAnataH । devadevaM hfzIkeSaM BUtezu praBavAvyayam ॥ prIRayAmi susaMprIto mama pApaM vyapohatu । evaM pradakziRaM kftvA vizRuloke mahIyate ॥ * ॥ dvAdaSyAM samupozyEva padmanABaM taTASvine ! pUjayedviDivadBaktyA ganDaDUpavilepanEH । ganDaDenuM tato dadyAt karpUrAgurucandanEH । kuNkumena hi rAjendra vittaSAWyaM vivarjjayet ॥ ekArRavagate toye svapato yasya veDasaH । nivAsAya BavannAByAM padmanABo'si ityuta ॥ prIyatAM padmanABo me duskftaM copaSAmyatu । ityuktvA taM samaByarccya dadyAt DenuM dvijAyate ॥ ityevaM kzapamARasya tasya puRyamataH SfRu । saptajanmakftaM pApaM svalpaM vA yadi vA bahu । dagDvA tat sakalaM BUpa vizRulokaM sa gacCati ॥ * ॥ kArttikasya tu mAsasya ekAdaSyAmupozitaH । prasuptaM boDayedrAtrO SradDABaktisamanvitaH ॥ nftyErgItEstaTA vAdyErfgyajuHsAmamaNgalEH । bIRApaRavaSabdESca purARaSravaRena ca ॥ vAsudevakaTABiSca stotrEranyESca vAhavEH । suBAzitErindrajAlErBUmiSoBABireva ca ॥ puzpErDUpESca nEvedyErdIpavfkzaMSca SoBanEH । homErBakzyErapUpESca PalEH SAkESca pAyasEH । ikzorvikArErmaDunA drAkzAKoqEH sadAqimEH । kuWerakasya maYjaryyA sarjjikAlavaRena ca ॥ hfdyAByAM SvetaraktAByAM candanAByAYca sarvvadA । kuNku mAlaktakAByAYca raktasUtrEH sakaNkaREH ॥ taTA nAnAviDEH puzpErdravyErvIcikriyAGanEH । tasyAm rAtryAM vyatItAyAM dvAdaSyAmaruRodaye । snAtvA nadIjalEH puRyEH pratimAM snApayettataH ॥ utTitAM tvaparE ramyAM tAmrAM rOpyAM suvarRajAm । vEzRavI pratimA yatra citre suptA kkacit Bavet । tatra snAnAdipUjA ca vedyAM kAryyA ca vizRave ॥ AdO Gftena tElena maDunA tadanantaram । daDnA kzIreRa ca tataH paYcagavyena SAstravit ॥ udvarttanaM mAzacUrRaM masUrAmalakAni ca । rODraM kAlIyakaYcEva nAgaraM varRakaM taTA ॥ sarzapASca priyaNguSca mAtuluNgarasEstaTA । sarvvOzaDyaH sarvvaganDAH sarvvabIjAni kAYcanam ॥ mANgalyAni yaTAlABaM ratnAni ca kuSodakam । hastidantodDftA mfcca vfzaSfNgodDftA taTA ॥ nadItorAdgavAM sTAnAt valmIkAt saNgamAt hradAt । dvandvasTAnAcca sarasastaTA parvvatamastakAt ॥ etABiH snApya deveSa dadyAt gorocanAM SuBAm tatastu kalasA deyA yaTAprAptaM svalaNkftAH ॥ jAtIpallavasaMyuktAH saPalASca sakAYcanAH । puRyAhavedaSabdena vIRAveRuraveRa ca ॥ Sabdena maDureREva sUtamAgaGavandinAm । evaM saMsTApya govindaM svanuliptaM svalaNkftam ॥ suvAsaM pUjayettantu sumanoBiSca kuNkumEH । dIpErDUpErmanojYESca pAyasena tu BUriRA ॥ nAnAratnapradAnESca homEH puRyEH sadakziREH । vAsoBirBUzaRErhfdyErgIBiraSvErgajErapi ॥ brAhmaRAH pUjanIyASca vizRorAdyAH sumUrttayaH । vizRo rAtrO prasuptasya dAmodaragataM yataH ॥ brahmARqasya ca tenAsi dAmodara iti smftaH । dAmodara imAM DenuM gfhRAtu svayameva hi ॥ dvijarUpeRa te vizRo prakftyezA sanAtanI । ityevaM pfTivIdAnAt PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥ suvarRasya mahADenuM dattvA nfpavarottamaH । hatvA pApAnyaSezARi SatajanmAntarARi vE ॥ vEzRavaM lokamApnoti yAvadindrAScaturddaSa । samyagatra vrate cIrRe saptajanmAnugaM Palam ॥ dadAti BagavAn vizRuH kAmAn mokzaM nareSvara । brAhmaRAn BojayedBaktyA BakzEruccAvacErapi ॥ tataH pradakziRaM kftvA yaTASaktyA ca dakziRAm । kalasAn dvAdaSEvEvaM brAhmaReByaH pradApayet ॥ vastreRAvezwitagrIvAn hemagarBopaSoBitAn । daDikzIrayutAMScE va saguqAn nfpa BUriSaH । SaktiryaTA taTA dadyAt BaktirevAtra kAraRam ॥ prasaNgenApi yo rAjan sunAmadvAdaSIM naraH । karoti puRyaBAgI sa yaTA dEtyodBavo baliH ॥ evaM yaH kurute rAjan sunAmadvAdaSIM naraH । rAjasUyasya yajYasya PalaM samaDikaM Bavet ॥ sarvvadAnezu yat puRyaM yacca puRyaM tapovane । sarvvatIrTezu yat puRyaM tat puRyaM samudAhftam ॥ gAvo dvAdaSa dAtavyA vastrayugmAni kAYcanam । alABe cEva gAmekAM pAtraM vA svarRasaMyutam ॥ mAse mAse'TavApyevaM caYcalaM jIvitaM yataH । bahuviGnA hi Darmmasya karttuSCidraM na jAyate ॥ etajjYAtvA sumeDAvI na tatra glapayenmanaH । na tasya vittalABo'sti BaktigrAhyo hi keSavaH ॥ anena viDinA yastu dvAdaSIM prativatsaram । kftvA naraH paraM yAti vizRulokamanAmayam ॥ sunAmadvAdaSI cEva vratAnAmuttamA nfpa । AdyA narEstu karttavyA tozayadBirjanArddanam ॥ yaScEnAM kIttayet puRyAM SfRuyAt dvAdaSIM naraH ॥ tAvuBO gacCataH svargaM karttA vizRupuraM vrajet ॥” iti vahripurARe sunAmadvAdaSInAmADyAyaH ॥
